arrival.text: I'm Meera Iyer. For the next year, every mistake you make is my mistake. So you won't make many.

choose.text: Sorry, Dr. Iyer. The bus... no. No excuses. It won't happen again.
It's 6:58. Technically I'm two minutes early.

then.text: Two minutes early is late here. Technically.

choose.text: I walked round the block twice before I could come in.

then.text: Twice? Good. Nervous doctors check things twice. Keep that.
then.head: nod

arrival.text: This coffee is mine. This is yours.
Dr. Iyer: Welcome to Riverside. Sister Grace is at the desk.
When it beeps, you move. Go and meet Sister Grace at the desk. She runs this hospital. I just operate in it.

grace.text: So you're the new intern. {called}, is it?
Rule one: wash your hands. Rule two: see rule one.
grace.head: nod

choose.text: I've heard you're the one who really runs this place.

then.text: Flattery. Good start. It won't get you out of night shifts.
Rule three: never ask a nurse what rule three is. Come back tomorrow.

choose.text: Understood. Where do I sign in?

then.text: Register's there. Smile next time. It's free.

grace.text: Your locker is 214. Your ID badge comes tomorrow, if HR remembers. HR rarely remembers.

grace_again.text: Locker 214. Hands washed. Go and be useful.

nair.text: Are you a real doctor? You look about twelve.

choose.text: Twelve and a half, sir. The half matters.

then.text: Ha! A doctor with jokes. That's new.

choose.text: Fully qualified, as of a few weeks ago. How long have you been waiting?
choose.detail: Mr. Nair has waited since 6 a.m. with a swollen knee, and nobody has asked him about it.

then.text: Since six. My knee is the size of a coconut. Nobody asks me anything.
You asked. Write that down somewhere.

choose.text: I'm a doctor. Please wait your turn.

then.text: Waiting is all I do. I'm a professional.

leela.text: He swallowed a coin. He says it was an accident. It was not.

choose.text: Most coins pass on their own. Has he been sick, or in pain?

then.text: No pain. He ate two biscuits on the way here. Greedy, not sick.

choose.text: At least it wasn't a big one.

then.text: It was a five rupee coin, Doctor. It was a big one.

leela.text: The scan room said one hour. That was two hours ago.

leela_again.text: Still waiting for the scan. Aarav has found another coin. I'm watching him.

then.text: Mr. Nair says you asked how long he'd waited. Nobody asks. Remember that feeling.
then.head: nod

then.text: And tomorrow, be early by more than two minutes.

iyer_report.text: That's Day 1. Tomorrow, seven sharp, the skills lab. Grace and I will find out what your hands can do.
Now go home. Sleep. Come back sharper.
iyer_report.head: nod

iyer_waiting.text: Go on. Sister Grace first, then say hello to someone in the waiting area. Then come back to me.

iyer_again.text: Home. Sleep. That's an order, Doctor.
